text:
B is better. It finds the same critical bug as A: the `WHERE p.status = 'succeeded'` filter drops customers with no payments. B also explains that customers whose only payments failed are dropped too. B then raises issues that matter for a call list. Annual and quarterly subscribers would show zero payments in 90 days without being at risk, and cancelled or brand-new accounts would be included. Refunds counted as successful payments is another real concern. A's date-format point is overstated, and its minor points are filler. A also runs well over the 200-word limit, while B stays close to it.

B
